tool_input.description: Inspect the JSON run history and CI config

result:
- **Cause:** runner-06 was slow, not this MR. Every recorded failure of this test (4 runs, one failure signature) is on runner-06, including one on `main` at `32f21f2`, which doesn't have the gift-message change. The same commits pass in about 90–105 ms on runners 01–05, and on runner-06 itself at other times (90–93 ms, against 515–555 ms when it fails). The batch test never sets `GiftMessage`, so the new code adds only a null check to that path.

- **Action:** I changed nothing. The 250 ms budget already has about 2.5x headroom over normal runs, so raising it would only weaken the guard to hide a runner problem. The pipeline is not green yet: this checkout has no git remote, so I couldn't retry the job from here.

To get it green, retry the `test` job; it should pass on any runner other than runner-06, and usually on runner-06 too. Separately, someone should look at runner-06 for contention or fewer cores (the test renders on all cores), since it will keep failing this test intermittently on `main` as well.
